# BOHOL

> BOHOL is a source-direct intelligent vending machine manufacturer based in Panyu, Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.

## Core company facts

- 8 years of manufacturing and R&D experience as of 2026.
- Operates a 20,000 square metre modern manufacturing facility.
- Provides OEM and ODM development for global brands, distributors and vending operators.
- Product and process references include 72-hour aging tests, ISO 9001, CE and RoHS.
- Serves customers and partners in more than 30 countries.

## Main product categories

- Vape vending machines: https://www.boholvending.com/vending-machines/vape-vending-machine
- Cold drink vending machines: https://www.boholvending.com/vending-machines/cold-drink-vending-machine
- Elevator delivery vending machines: https://www.boholvending.com/vending-machines/elevator-vending-machine
- Eyelash and beauty vending machines: https://www.boholvending.com/vending-machines/eyelash-vending-machine

## Capabilities

- Cabinet, channel and delivery-system engineering
- Touchscreen UI, language and software localization
- Payment, connectivity, voltage and plug configuration
- Private-label branding, prototype validation and scalable manufacturing
